'''Quenches''' are an item that will purify [[Infested Blocks]] from [[:Category:Nexus Parasites#Beckons|Stage I, II, or III Beckons]] when thrown.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
{{CraftingTable
|r1_b1=Blaze Rod
|r1_a2=Blaze Rod
|r1_c2=Blaze Rod
|r1_b3=Blaze Rod
|r1_b2=Magma Cream
|r1_output=Quench
|r1_count=3
}}

== ''Usage'' ==
Right clicking a Quench will throw it as a projectile, such as an egg or snowball, but it will fly slower and fall faster. When it hits a block, it will immediately purify all [[Infested Blocks]] within a 15x15 area of the block that the projectile hits, then purify the surrounding blocks progressively by radius. Note that the resulting blocks can still be re-infested by any surrounding infested blocks or Beckons.

== ''Trivia'' ==
*The Quench has been in the game for a long time, but previously had a placeholder texture, was unnamed, unobtainable, and acted as a [[Debug Items|Debug Item]]. It was also required that an Infested block was hit, and it only purified infested blocks horizontally.
*The Item is toxic to Parasites due to their weakness to fire.
